suppress.notes: False positive: CPE maps Micrometer Prometheus registry to Prometheus server
False positive: CPE maps Eclipse Angus Activation to Angus Mail

Mitigated CVE-2026-47884 (XsltView SSRF/RCE): application does not register or use XsltView / XSLT view resolution; controllers return JSON via @RestController only. No catch-all /** view mappings. Framework 6.2.20+ is not published to Maven Central for OSS consumers.

Mitigated CVE-2026-59313 (SSE CRLF injection): application does not use Spring MVC functional routing (WebMvc.fn) or ServerResponse.sse(...). APIs are annotated @RestController / @RestControllerAdvice only. Framework 6.2.20+ is not published to Maven Central for OSS consumers.
